$comment: Source-of-truth for the media pipeline (scripts/prepare-media.mjs). Paths are relative to MEDIA_SOURCE_DIR (default: the folder above website/). Only entries with publish:true are processed into public/. Withheld entries document why they are not on the site. This file is never imported by the app, so original paths stay private.

brand.$comment: R7 monogram supplied on 2026-10-16: white R, red 7, transparent background. An ink-R variant is generated for light backgrounds.
